snippet.title: SPACR Alpha Preview
snippet.description:
SPACR is an open-world adventure game about a fox mechanic stranded on a mysterious planet where tools are forbidden.

Play as Vix - an unlucky SPACR (space mechanic) who is about to get fired. Solve quirky puzzles, meet adorable characters, eat delicious food in a first-person view!
Fix things and destinies using improbable tools.

http://spacr-game.com/
